name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evol
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evolve 4 qubits with 5 layers of random rotations U, apply U^dagger, and verify the system returns to |0...0> with probability 1; then perturb one angle by 0.31 and report the echo decay. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
